# nodes/cache

> 标签: cache, laravel, nodes

## 简介

Makes it easier to control and manage Laravel caching

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://packagist.org/packages/nodes%2Fcache
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/nodes-php/nodes-php-cache.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/nodes%2Fcache
